data.name: Boyd
data.long_meaning: Originally from the Scottish Gaelic name 'Bodach', meaning 'young man' or 'boy'. The name is derived from the Old English 'bodga', meaning 'to serve' or 'to be a guardian'.

in_hebrew.name: בויד
